scope: Only planning documents and docs/post-mvp/mockups; no application verification or release gate run.

checks.description: 19 primary views × 4 sizes × normal and warnings states, with 23 synthetic students.

p13TwoStudentGrid.actionSurface: neutral grouped card; no filled blue action buttons
p13TwoStudentGrid.assignAffordance: blue plus ring above 350px; blue text plus leading inset at 320px

p14DestinationPopup.states: green assigned, blue available, grey unavailable

interactions.observed: Two recent notes are visible only for the populated profile; Altre note opens the remaining labelled notes on demand; the header action is labelled Modifica; the Valutazioni card reuses the complete weekly grid from P18/P19.
Selecting a day opens P13 directly with no intermediate dialog; cards with different content remain aligned at the top.

Ordinary student cards stay two per row from 430px through 320px. A student assigned to multiple days spans both columns so Sab, Mer and both removal controls remain visible. The blue filled action surface and the introductory banner are absent; assignment remains a 44px name action with a discreet plus affordance.

Student name and five 40px evaluation controls share one row at all four widths with no horizontal overflow. The name button opens the note and retains the full accessible name when visually truncated.

The destination popup lists boats in numeric order and reuses P15's three state colors without horizontal overflow at all four widths. Double-clicking Giulia increases Disponibili from 3 to 4 and leaves the original crew slot free.

Grey, green and blue boat states are simultaneously visible with a legend and six normalized model logos. Selecting Equipaggio 5 without a boat and then blue First 25.7 14 makes First 25.7 14 green and updates the crew summary. This mock mutation is in memory only.
Ordinamento appears above Alfabetico and Valutazione; sorting controls and student name headers are 40 CSS px high and the overview has no horizontal overflow.
Course identity, scan counters, duty coverage, crew warnings, evaluation toggle, blank evaluation cells and P19 hierarchy remain operational in the isolated mock.

limitations: Measurements describe synthetic layouts and primary interactive states, not every production state.
No physical-device, 200% text, contrast certification or production accessibility claim.
At 320px P17 gives the name column 78px so long names may be visually truncated; the full name remains in the title and accessible label.
No persistence, OCR accuracy, voice latency or cross-session integrity verification.

P19 is approved and the visual structure of P15 is approved. P04 keeps its r5 approval but the added weekly grid needs review. Human review of the r10 target on P13, the r8 target on P17 and the r7 targets on P14/P16 remains required; P18 is an approved r6 treatment with a compact r7 fix.
